posts.title: Pixel Area got a heartbeat
posts.description: I only wanted to show which blogs were updated recently. Then came a filter, then "latest" lines, and now Pixel Area has Pulse. The whole story is in the new post . Don't see your blog in Pulse? Check your RSS or write to hello@pxlarea.com.

posts.title: A blog on Friday the 13th. And badges.
posts.description: Friday the 13th – a fine day to start something important. I honestly didn’t plan it around the date, it just worked out that way, but… today Pixel Area got its own blog. The first post is a not-so-simple story about badges. Small rectangles that caused a fair amount of trouble, and I still love them. Do you?

posts.title: Pixel Area is live
posts.description: I built Pixel Area because I like the small, personal websites that are still out there – and because finding them can be harder than it should be. So I made a map. Not a list: on a list something is always first. It's a 100×100 grid with a space for each site. Blogs, newsletters, digital gardens – any personal corner of the web can have its own pixel.
